summary: StimCell Energetics filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, reporting an Advisory Services Agreement dated August 24, 2026, with Stonegate Capital Markets, Inc., a Texas corporation and affiliate of Stonegate Capital Partners. Stonegate acts as non-exclusive advisor on a best-efforts basis to introduce prospective investors and strategic counterparties for potential transactions involving the Company's assets, property, rights, debt or equity securities, subject to Company approval. Compensation is a percentage of Gross Proceeds from any asset sale, with a three-month initial term terminable on 30 days' notice. No transaction terms were disclosed.
